statusDoctrine.pass: Surface consumes a registered contract id and exposes enough posture for proof or user review.
statusDoctrine.partial: Surface consumes contract-backed data but does not yet expose the contract id or trust posture clearly.
statusDoctrine.gap: Surface computes or displays suite-truth metrics without a registered contract id.
statusDoctrine.outOfScope: Surface is related domain functionality but needs a future domain-specific contract, not one of the four current suite contracts.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Operational health summary and correction-priority alert ranking.
surfaces.notes: Runtime DTOs echo both operational health and correction priority contract ids.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Derives segment set metrics from canonical TerraFusion DB tables.
surfaces.notes: SegmentDerivationResult echoes the registered segment derivation contract id.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Same-population ratio-study parity, population contract fields, and parity rows.
surfaces.notes: The panel displays contractId, population, trustPosture, sale window, qualification policy, suppression policy, outlier policy, conversion-sensitive counts, and parity rows.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Displays median ratio, COD, PRD, critical/warning counts, needs-data count, and exceptions.
surfaces.notes: Uses healthSummary and visibly exposes operational contract id, correction priority contract id, and county trust posture.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Displays operational health metrics, top action items, and composite-risk explanation.
surfaces.notes: Visible health surface now exposes operational contract id, correction priority contract id, and county trust posture.

surfaces.surface: County Studio correction and defense panel
surfaces.metricBehavior: Shows defense readiness, county posture, correction counts, and evidence readiness.
surfaces.notes: Defense readiness now exposes operational contract id, correction priority contract id, and county trust posture alongside current anchors.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Displays deterministic findings, evidence values, and recommended actions.
surfaces.notes: Diagnosis output is metric-shaped and action-shaping, but no contract id, population, or proof artifact is visible in the response or UI.

surfaces.surface: Evidence packet modal and markdown export
surfaces.metricBehavior: Exports DOR-defensible packet with correction-priority contract id and segment signals.
surfaces.notes: Correction contract is visible. A future improvement can attach county trust tier directly.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Colors parcels for ratio-like metric overlays, scenario deltas, cohort shading, and edge warnings.
surfaces.notes: Overlay values are styled by local threshold helpers without a contract id or source population.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Loads Washington launch county status, Benton compatibility geometry, staged sales, and review counts.
surfaces.notes: It labels geometry availability, but Washington 39-county launch status remains outside the registered suite metric contracts.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Computes sales-weighted median ratio, COD, PRD, PRB, pass rate, equity index, and worst neighborhoods client-side.
surfaces.notes: This is the largest adoption gap: it recomputes county health-like truth locally instead of consuming terraforge_operational_health_v1 or statistics compat output.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Computes AI priority score from COD deviation, median-ratio deviation, PRB deviation, and sale count.
surfaces.notes: The priority formula is local and not registered as correction priority or a separate CostForge calibration contract.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Displays qualification counts, median ratio, weighted mean, COD, PRD, PRB, and IAAO compliance.
surfaces.notes: This should either adopt statistics_ratio_study_compat_v1 semantics or declare a distinct sale-qualification running-stats contract.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Filters qualified sales, sorts by ratio, and flags outliers using local thresholds.
surfaces.notes: Qualification and outlier behavior overlaps the Statistics Compat population contract but is not explicitly tied to it.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Loads comparable county sales, filters qualified sales, scores candidates, and runs governed adjustment/reconciliation.
surfaces.notes: This does not fit the four current suite metric contracts cleanly. It needs a future comparable-sales candidate-selection/reconciliation contract.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Computes RCNLD, cost factors, matrix provenance, API verification, and cost commit gate.
surfaces.notes: This is governed in its own cost domain but not covered by the four TerraForge suite metric contracts. A CostForge cost-value contract should be registered later.

surfaces.metricBehavior: Calls MassAppraisal ratio-study, strata, outlier, comparison, and segment endpoints.
surfaces.notes: The standalone statistics shell is retired, but this client still exposes ratio-study-shaped behavior with no contract id.

nextClosures: Add visible contract/trust posture badges to County Studio command, health, and correction-defense panels.
Move GeoForge county health and Atlas metric overlays to consume contract-backed County Studio/Statistics Compat outputs or label them as uncontracted diagnostics.
Bring SalesForge running stats and ratio audit under statistics_ratio_study_compat_v1 or register a distinct sale-qualification stats contract.
Register future CostForge and CompsForge domain contracts before treating their calculations as suite truth.
